hook: Your spaceship can sail on sunlight.
title: A Spaceship Really Sailed on Sunlight
description:
Japan's IKAROS unfurled a thin square solar sail in 2010. It was the first to do so in interplanetary space, and it flew toward Venus. Part of the Space Firsts series.

#Shorts #Technology #SpaceFirsts
comment_prompt: Would you ride a solar sail? Yes or no
